Lombalgia in RM (2/6): uomo, T1 e T2 sag: Low back pain on MRI (2/6): man, sagittal T1 and T2 at 3 T
Ernia discale posteriore L5-S1 con disco: Posterior L5-S1 disc herniation with a less hydrated disc (Pfirrmann 3); other discs normal (Pfirrmann 1) (SPIDER 95)
Uomo con storia di lombalgia. RM del rac: Man with a history of low back pain. Lumbar spine MRI without contrast: sagittal T1 and T2. Age and other clinical data are not available in the collection.
Descrivi i dischi e indica il livello de: Describe the discs and give the level of the main finding.
L5-S1 e L4-L5 sono i livelli più colpiti:
L5-S1 and L4-L5 are the levels most often affected by lumbar herniations. A posterolateral L5-S1 herniation usually compresses the S1 root (pain and sensory changes in the back of the leg and the lateral edge of the foot, reduced ankle reflex); a foraminal herniation at the same level compresses L5 instead.
To tell the side and which root is compressed you need axial images: on sagittal images alone you see that the disc bulges into the canal, not to which side.
A disc losing T2 signal at a single level, with the others normal, indicates localised degeneration, often at the level of the herniation.
Sagittali: livello e sporgenza; assiali:: Sagittals: level and protrusion; axials: side and root.
Gradazioni del radiologo muscoloscheletr: Grading by the SPIDER collection musculoskeletal radiologist: L5-S1 herniation, Modic type 2 endplate changes, Pfirrmann 3; upper levels Pfirrmann 1, no changes.
Come si individua il livello?: How do you identify the level?
Qual è la conclusione più adatta?: What is the most appropriate conclusion?
Ernia discale posteriore L5-S1 che impro: Posterior L5-S1 disc herniation indenting the thecal sac, with the disc less bright on T2 than the others
Serie 1 (T2), immagini 10-12: il margine: Series 1 (T2), images 10-12: the posterior margin of the L5-S1 disc bulges into the canal and the nuclear signal is reduced. Collection grading: herniation, Pfirrmann 3 (also Modic type 2 endplate changes, hardly visible on these images).
Dischi da L1-L2 a L4-L5 normali: nucleo: Discs from L1-L2 to L4-L5 normal: bright nucleus on T2 and preserved height
Stenosi del canale su più livelli con ip: Multilevel canal stenosis with ligamentum flavum hypertrophy
Il canale è ampio ai livelli superiori;: The canal is wide at the upper levels; the finding is limited to L5-S1.
I muri posteriori di L5 e di S1 sono all: The posterior walls of L5 and S1 are aligned.
Si contano i dischi dal sacro: il disco: Count the discs from the sacrum: the abnormal disc is the first one, between L5 and S1
Nelle sagittali lombari si parte dal sac: On lumbar sagittal images you start from the sacrum (S1, the first fused vertebra) and count upwards. With a lumbosacral transitional vertebra the count must be confirmed with the ribs or with thoracic spine images: lumbar sagittals alone are not enough.
Si contano i dischi dall'alto partendo d: Count the discs from the top, starting from the first disc visible in the image
Il primo disco in alto dipende da dove è: The top disc depends on where the field of view is centred: it may be T11-T12 or T12-L1. The reliable landmark is the sacrum.
Ernia discale posteriore L5-S1; gli altr: Posterior L5-S1 disc herniation; the other lumbar discs are normal
Discopatia degenerativa diffusa su tutti: Diffuse degenerative disc disease at all levels
Solo L5-S1 è alterato: gli altri dischi: Only L5-S1 is abnormal: the other discs are normal.
